reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume has roughly doubled since August 2026 (E-07), and the majority of disputed bills carry an ACTUAL meter read rather than an ESTIMATED one (E-01), which rules out field/AMI read-delivery estimate-substitution and slow ticket-response handling (E-03) as the dominant drivers. This pattern implicates a defect in the billing import and validation step itself — most plausibly a change to billing validation rules around August (H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE) — producing incorrect bill calculations on accounts regardless of read type, which customers then dispute.
